title: The Snipped Blue Orchid
scene: At 11:15 AM, staff found the prized orchid snipped from its pot in the glasshouse. Only the curator saw the silver shears left behind.

suspects.name: Fiona Frost
suspects.testimony: I locked the office at 11:00 AM and greeted donors at the fountain until 11:15 AM, when I found the pot.
suspects.alibiProof: Three donors confirm Fiona stayed with them by the fountain from 11:00 to 11:15 AM.

suspects.name: Arthur Wren
suspects.testimony: I sipped tea on the terrace from 10:55 to 11:20 AM; I never even went near the glasshouse.
suspects.alibiProof: The terrace waiter poured Arthur's tea at 11:00 AM and chatted with him until 11:20 AM.

suspects.name: Daphne Brooks
suspects.testimony: I was arranging centerpieces in the parlor from 11:00 to 11:20 AM—I don't even own silver shears!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned silver shears yet, and blue orchid pollen was dusted across Daphne's cuff.

suspects.name: Simon Tate
suspects.testimony: I trimmed hedges just outside the glasshouse door from 11:00 to 11:15 AM, carrying my rusty clippers.
suspects.alibiProof: A tour group watched Simon trimming the outer hedges from 11:00 to 11:15 AM.
